records.publisher: Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (official treaty edition)
topics: treaty entry into force versus effective date
dividends 8 percent ceiling subject to conditions
interest and technical fees 10 percent ceilings
beneficial ownership and principal-purpose anti-abuse test
records.publication_date: Signed 2024-09-23; entered into force 2026-04-20; tax effect in Kenya from 2027-01-01
records.syllabus_scope: Advanced international taxation; illustrative future-effective treaty, not current 2026 withholding rates
records.accuracy_review: Official PDF cover dates checked; Articles 10(2), 11(2), 13(2), 28, 29(2) inspected. Kenya WHT treaty provisions take effect for amounts paid/accrued from 2027-01-01. Treaty rates are ceilings, not unconditional mandatory tax; domestic rate, residency, beneficial ownership, PE and anti-abuse conditions matter. Singapore non-WHT income years of assessment have different timing under Art 29.
